edits.before: W is your matchup answer; hold it for HIS key spell only. Only take the trade when Mordekaiser's Realm of Death is down.
edits.after: Rank-2 Obliterate hits harder on you alone and his W heals off the trade — his window. Hold Riposte; fight once Bladework is up.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Realm of Death's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: His shield is thickest here and isolated Obliterate is only on a 5s cooldown at rank 4 — do not brawl through it. Farm, and hold for level 6.

edits.before: Grand Challenge paints four vitals and the heal field wins any committed duel. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Mordekaiser's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Grand Challenge paints four vitals and the heal field out-sustains his W. Realm of Death is a 140s cooldown at rank 1 — bait or Riposte the cast and win the duel.

edits.before: - Mordekaiser Realm of Death: matchup-defining — His 1v1 realm. Out-duel him inside it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Realm of Death: 140/120/100s — his only way to win the 1v1. Track it; engage the moment it is spent. - His Q is 8s at rank 1, down to 4s at rank 5 — step in after he whiffs it. - Riposte (24s): keep it for his E pull or his R cast.
